newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian nickel prices fall, aluminium unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Indian nickel prices fall, aluminium unchanged.

text.p: Indian nickel prices on Thursday fell while other metals were steady in a narrow trading range, dealers said.

Nickel eased by 100 rupees at 37,000 rupees per quintal on fresh arrivals while reports of a setback in the world market prompted profit-taking. Copper was steady at 13,500 rupees per quintal, zinc at 7,750 rupees and lead at 4,550 rupees per quintal on limited activity.
Volumes were at a low ebb as major players kept away ahead of closing accounts for the March 31 year-end.
Aluminium was available at the previous level of 7,425 rupees and tin too at 31,600 rupees per quintal amid nominal trading.
Overall market sentiments remained quiet at the close of the session. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
